svg.title: Arospi Escort - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 42-43, PDF 43-44. Interpreted combined envelope retains upper deck long pointed leaf body and lower deck narrow projecting aft spike, corroborated by illustration. Relative longitudinal alignment is inferred from aft machinery/body relationships; exact placement is not fixed by plan layout. Broad upper body contains lower fuel hull. Detached turret keys and interior engineering borders excluded.
